name: Byzantines 1 TC Aggression (Beasty)
author: Sabrosito

notes: @building_economy/house.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@, @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ at gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/sheep.webp@. Stone vils stay there until 5 @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@.
2nd @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ on home @resource/berrybush.webp@, where your @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ will be. Set it to increase research.

@age/age_2.webp@ with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@,  @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@. All others to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, leave 4 on @resource/resource_food.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Remember to add @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ whenever you have 120 @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Prio @resource/berrybush.webp@ but get as many res as you can, but be safe.
Keep @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@. 8 to sustain units, 10 so you can slowly add @building_economy/farm.webp@, 9 is a decent middle ground.

All 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@and all 3@abilities/repair.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ for 7 total. @resource/rally.webp@@resource/berrybush.webp@ for mercs.
Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@  @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ and another military building depending on what you scout on the enemy ASAP.

Remember the others @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, and important @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ techs.
Make some units, harass. Figure out if the enemy wants to continue fighting or not. If not, aim for @age/age_3.webp@.

Rebalance eco to prep for @age/age_3.webp@. Pull ~5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to extra @resource/berrybush.webp@ with @building_defensive/outpost.webp@. Pull the @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Get @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or @resource/rally.webp@ to them.
Rebalance eco. Get 9-10 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so you can slowly add @building_economy/farm.webp@.
At this point you can all in. Don't forget @resource/relics.webp@. Keep producing and putting on pressure.

description:
Play when against aggro civs. If against passive, play the 2 TC one. Some pointers:
1. Remember to build cisterns ASAP when you get 120 stone.
2. Important to scout enemy and produce the counters in Feudal.
    a. If enemy is pro scouts, get spears + longbow and deny deer packs.
    b. If enemy is archers, get horsemen + longbow.
3. Expend all Gaia food before adding farms, especially berries.
